'''Rock crystal''', one of many types of quartz crystals (SiO<sub>2</sub>), is a type of [[gem]]. When rough rock crystals are combined with [[pearlash]] at a [[glass furnace]], it can be used to make [[glass|crystal glass]] items.  Cut rock crystals can't be used for this purpose.

Crystal glass is slightly complicated to produce, but can also be cut into gems with five times the material value, made into crafts and furniture that will keep your dwarves happy, and even utilized as a [[magma safe]] building material.
